open_points.subject: record_change
open_points.text: - record_change: [VALIDATION_ERROR] For RecordAttemptOutcomeChange and RecoverInFlightChange MUST raise RefusedError, writing nothing, when the named attempt's attempt_number is no longer one more than the number of NodeExecutions of its element; the concluding NodeExecution then takes that attempt's number. Any other broken invariant (a linked record missing, an identity already present for an immutable record, a status change from a status the change does not start from) or a failed transaction raises StoreInternalError with nothing written.
open_points.other_text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] A StoredValue whose value_id already exists is not written again and the existing record is returned in its place, since equal values share one identity; spooled files must already be published in the run's spool by spool_file before the change that writes their SpooledFile records.
open_points.question: Must an existing StoredValue identity raise StoreInternalError as an identity already present for an immutable record, or must an equal existing StoredValue be reused and returned? The invariant-error passage must exclude this StoredValue case, or the reuse passage must change.
